text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about rain! Who cares about mud!
I'll take it all head-on and blow it all away!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
DORYAAAAAAAHHH!!!
CHAAAAAARGE!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! Kitasan Black
powers through the mud with sheer grit!
She crosses the line with absolute majesty, and—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She stands firm right in the middle of the track!
No need to worry! No need to worry at all!
The crowd of 60,000 is stunned! Breathless...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What... what was that run just now...?
Without even flinching through the worst part of the turf...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"That's Kitasan for you, that's just who she is.
Even in places everyone else avoids,
she dives right in on her own...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH, that's it,
Kitasan!! You're the best, absolutely the best!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
You're so freaking amazing!
DAMMITTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in thunderous cheers, the expression on her face is...
Not so much joy, but the quiet fulfillment of having fulfilled her duty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Our helpful general paid no heed to the swirling wind and rain, winning the smiles of everyone.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan... amazing... you're so amazing...
I could only think about winning myself.
But...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan is different. Rather than just winning,
she's aiming even higher...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I can't stand alongside them like this. I can't
win like this. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Before the Arima Kinen, I need to push myself even further...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Trainer!
I ran just as we planned, and it actually worked!
choice_data_list: No, it's all thanks to your power, Kitasan!
No, it was all thanks to your strength, Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A strategy that couldn't work without immense grit
and heavy track aptitude. It was an achievement born solely
from their absolute faith in each other's abilities.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That was a tremendous run, Kitasan Black-san!
It truly felt like a festival of mud, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The weather was bad,
but I worked hard to make up for it
so everyone would still have a great time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I made things really hard for the fans today, but next time I'll do even—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I want everyone to have a blast with a cheerful,
grand-scale festival!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: On a grand scale... Which means...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! A global festival where incredible Umamusume gather together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll be running alongside formidable rivals at the Japan Cup! Let's bring the hype to Tokyo Racecourse once again!
